title: Ferrowave Developer Docs
description: Guides, API reference and changelog for the Ferrowave payments platform.

title: Webhooks | Ferrowave Docs
description: Receive events from Ferrowave. Every delivery is signed; see Verifying signatures.

title: Verifying webhook signatures | Ferrowave Docs
description: Verify the Ferrowave-Signature-V2 header (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp and body) on every webhook delivery.

title: Webhook retries | Ferrowave Docs
description: Failed webhook deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 3 days.

title: API keys | Ferrowave Docs
description: Create restricted API keys. Legacy v1 API keys stop working on December 1, 2026.

title: Changelog | Ferrowave Docs
description: Release notes for the Ferrowave API and SDKs.

title: Legacy v1 documentation | Ferrowave Docs
description: Archived documentation for the Ferrowave v1 API, including v1 webhooks.

title: Webhooks (v1, archived) | Ferrowave Docs
description: v1 webhooks are signed with the X-Ferrowave-Sig header (HMAC-SHA1). v1 webhooks are supported until June 30, 2026.

title: Introducing signed webhooks v2 | Ferrowave Blog
description: Webhook signatures v2 use HMAC-SHA256 and include a timestamp to stop replay attacks. Migration details are in the docs.
